summary: A second Balance playstyle with Wrath as the only filler, for a moonkin that would rather not weave; it trades Moonglow for Heart of the Wild and uses Natural Power gloves. It is 6.1% behind the default Balance build.
rotation: Pre-pull: Wrath cast 1.5 s before the pull
Racials, potions and runes on cooldown (Innervate on its own trigger)
Insect Swarm whenever it is down (more than 8 s of fight left)
Moonfire whenever its dot is down (more than 8 s of fight left)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 36 spell power and 15 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
6.1% behind the weaving Balance build (776.5 vs 827.0 at 180 s)
Wrath rank 8 may be about 17% low on the client: holding it to the level 30 ratio would give +1.6% (760 -> 772 on the gear before the 5a and 1b rounds)
Natural Power gloves are +8.1 over Arcane Power for this build
Heart of the Wild 3 over Moonglow 3 is +2.6 in its own search
notes: Request from mksettings -spec balance with the Wrath gear variant, apl and talents; same consumes, buffs and encounter as the Balance build (shared EncounterLevel60). Duration 180 s, durationVariation 20. No edits needed.
